texts: good. the obligation is recorded as a standing norm on newcomers as a kind, so any newcomer inherits it.
good. "each" yields a rule that reaches every newcomer individually, with "under a senior Keeper" kept as stated.
good. the denial covers exactly the solitary tending - the rule leaves "new apprentices tend lanterns" open and denies only the doing-it-alone.

mixed: the permission, the Council, the apprentice and the solo tending are all recorded, but because "begin" sits inside the permission the parse also marks the solo tending as already under way - something the sentence only permits, never asserts. If the inceptive nuance is not essential, rewrite as: "The Council permits an apprentice to tend alone." - otherwise expect a stray "is currently tending alone" reading alongside the permission.
